evidence.observation: Tube pressure held at ~2.98 Torr during the ramp, then rose steadily through growth to 3.437 Torr.
Exhaust O2 was ~4-6 ppm after the purge, then rose steadily during growth: 8.8, 17.7, 24.4, 33.9, 44.7, 51.5 ppm.
MFC reading stays at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint, so extra gas from the MFC does not explain the pressure rise.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with heater power steady, so the thermal side looks normal.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate check would confirm it: isolate the tube (stop Ar and close the exhaust) and watch whether pressure keeps rising, or leak-check the fittings. An exhaust blockage would raise pressure without adding O2, so that is less likely. No characterization data exists yet.
